sections.title: Case Study: Cancer
sections.description: This elective case study offers students the opportunity to learn about the etiology, diagnosis, and management of cancer across the lifespan. Building on existing clinical knowledge and skills, students will explore cancer care from the perspectives of prevention, early detection, treatment, survivorship, and death. Observational clinical experiences and selected case studies will enhance students' understanding of patients' and families' cancer experience. Class instruction includes small group discussion, case studies, and some lectures. Students will complete 12 clinical hours, to include observation, panels and tours of treatment areas.
